sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。
而且我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: Four score and seven years ago, our fathers brought forth on this continent a new nation.
sentences.zh: 八十七年前，我们的先辈在这片大陆上建立了一个新国家。

sentences.en: Conceived in liberty and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.
sentences.zh: 它孕育于自由之中，并致力于实现人人生而平等的理念。
欢迎大家来到葛底斯堡。

sentences.en: Written by Robert Padnick and directed by Jeffrey Blitz.
sentences.zh: 由罗伯特·帕德尼克编剧，杰弗里·布里茨执导。

sentences.en: Well, Ms. Lincoln, would you like to read us a summary?
sentences.zh: 那么，林肯女士，你愿意为我们读一下剧情梗概吗？

sentences.en: Andy is struggling to inspire his—I'm kidding.
sentences.zh: 安迪正努力激励他的——我开玩笑的。

sentences.en: He's struggling to inspire his employees.
sentences.zh: 他正努力激励他的员工们。

sentences.en: So he decides to take them on a corporate retreat to the Gettysburg Museum.
sentences.zh: 于是他决定带他们去葛底斯堡博物馆进行公司团建。

sentences.en: He even has custom hats made.
The employees who choose to stay at The Office are recruited by Robert California to brainstorm innovative game changers.
sentences.zh: 选择留在办公室的员工被罗伯特·加州招募，去进行创新性的头脑风暴。

sentences.en: And guess who gets Robert's attention?
sentences.zh: 你猜是谁引起了罗伯特的注意？

sentences.en: He's just going to have to be the hot guy now.
sentences.zh: 他现在只能当那个帅哥了。
关于宾夕法尼亚州的葛底斯堡。

sentences.en: Elise says, I have been waiting since the start of this podcast to write in about this episode because I grew up in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: Elise说，从这个播客开播起，我就一直等着写信问这一集，因为我是在宾夕法尼亚州的葛底斯堡长大的，

sentences.en: and this little town was absolutely tickled that we were chosen to be featured in this amazing sitcom.
sentences.zh: 我们这个小镇对于能被这部精彩的情景喜剧选中感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I know I can speak for the town when I say we were honored.
sentences.zh: 我代表全镇人民说，我们深感荣幸。

sentences.en: Elise goes on to say, it is obvious that the scenes located in Gettysburg were not actually filmed there.
sentences.zh: Elise接着说，很明显，在葛底斯堡的场景并不是真的在那里拍摄的。

sentences.en: I would love to hear a location breakdown.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听取景地解析。

sentences.en: I would also love to know if anyone from the cast or crew came to Gettysburg or if you were able to get donations from local businesses or tour our historic town.
sentences.zh: 我也很想知道是否有演职人员去过葛底斯堡，或者你们是否从当地企业获得过捐赠，又或者参观过我们这座历史名城。

sentences.en: Please, ladies, add the Gettysburg National Battlefield to your list of tourists to take.
sentences.zh: 女士们，请把葛底斯堡国家战场列入你们的旅游清单吧。

sentences.en: It is a beautiful area with an amazing history and wonderful people that all, including myself, would love to show you around.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美丽的地区，有着令人惊叹的历史和美好的人民，包括我在内的所有人，都非常乐意带你们四处看看。

sentences.en: I'm adding it to our liSt.
sentences.zh: 我把它加进我们的清单了。

sentences.en: Our list is getting really long.
sentences.zh: 我们的清单变得越来越长了。

sentences.en: It's going to require a lot of travel.
But I'm really looking forward to the season of my life where I am just kind of an older gal that gets to, like, go to fun places with my best friend.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很期待我人生中的那个阶段，那时我只是个老太太，可以和最好的朋友一起去有趣的地方玩。

sentences.en: You're literally describing my mom and dad.
sentences.zh: 你描述的简直就是我爸妈。

sentences.en: They travel around to different places in the United States and abroad.
sentences.zh: 他们在美国各地和国外旅行。

sentences.en: They go to the little charming places.
sentences.zh: 他们会去那些迷人的小地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're always finding some little nugget somewhere.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他们总能在某处发现一些小宝藏。

sentences.en: Well, Elise, we shot the Gettysburg scenes at Woodley Park in Van Nuys.
sentences.zh: 嗯，埃莉斯，我们在范奈斯的伍德利公园拍摄了葛底斯堡的场景。

sentences.en: The museum and archives were sets that we built on our warehouse stages.
sentences.zh: 博物馆和档案馆的场景是我们自己在仓库摄影棚里搭建的。

sentences.en: Our design team did a lot of research to try and make the park look like the real Gettysburg.
sentences.zh: 我们的设计团队做了大量的研究，试图让公园看起来像真正的葛底斯堡。

sentences.en: For example, Pam Punch, who was our NBC executive, grew up around Gettysburg and said,
sentences.zh: 例如，我们的NBC主管帕姆·潘奇，她是在葛底斯堡附近长大的，她说，
嘿，看起来还挺像那么回事的。

sentences.en: Our art department brought in the cannons.
sentences.zh: 我们的美术部门运来了大炮。

sentences.en: They brought in the signage and other kind of decorations to look like Gettysburg.
sentences.zh: 他们运来了标识牌和其他装饰品，让这里看起来像葛底斯堡。

sentences.en: And Phil Shea got a bunch of stuff from the actual Gettysburg Battlefield National Park gift store.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·谢伊从真正的葛底斯堡国家军事公园礼品店买了一堆东西。

sentences.en: Well, I reached out to Michael Gallenberg.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我联系了迈克尔·加伦伯格。

sentences.en: You guys have heard us talk about him before.
sentences.zh: 你们之前听我们提起过他。

sentences.en: And I wanted to know if he had any stories about putting this episode together.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他有没有关于制作这一集的故事。

sentences.en: He emailed me back right away.
sentences.zh: 他很快就给我回了邮件。

sentences.en: And he said, You know, Angela, Gettysburg was the end of my tenure on The Office.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道吗，安吉拉，葛底斯堡是我在《办公室》任期的终点。

sentences.en: He said, In fact, it might have been my last official episode.
sentences.zh: 他说，事实上，这可能是我最后参与的一集。

sentences.en: So Michael actually put me in touch with Matt Flynn from the design team.
sentences.zh: 所以迈克尔实际上帮我联系了设计团队的马特·弗林。

sentences.en: And he had such fun things to share about this episode.
sentences.zh: 他分享了关于这一集非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, first of all, he says, Greetings to you both, Jenna and Angela.
sentences.zh: 好的，首先，他说，向你们两位，珍娜和安吉拉问好。

sentences.en: And congratulations on your very popular podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你们的播客大受欢迎。

sentences.en: Great way to start an email to us.
sentences.zh: 给我们发邮件的绝佳开场白。

sentences.en: And then he went on to say, Yes, indeed, this episode was my first stint as production designer at The Office.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续说，没错，这一集确实是我在《办公室》担任美术指导的第一次任务。

sentences.en: However, he had been working with Michael Gallenberg as art director since season two.
sentences.zh: 不过，他从第二季开始就一直作为艺术总监与迈克尔·加伦伯格合作。

sentences.en: Yeah, he knew the show very well.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他非常了解这部剧。

sentences.en: He shared one of the demands of the script was to provide a, ready for this?
sentences.zh: 他分享说剧本的要求之一是提供一个——准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Here was his call to action.
We need you to provide for us a verdant setting,
sentences.zh: 我们需要你为我们提供一个绿意盎然的环境，

sentences.en: which has a parking lot adjacent to a plaza-like area in front of an existing structure where we could then turn it into a Gettysburg visitor center.
sentences.zh: 旁边要有一个停车场，连接着现有建筑前的一个广场区域，这样我们就能把它变成葛底斯堡游客中心。

sentences.en: So, Jenna, you mentioned there were cannons, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，珍娜，你提到了有大炮，对吧？

sentences.en: He said they did a lot of research.
sentences.zh: 他说他们做了很多研究。

sentences.en: They wanted to place them the way they were in the actual park.
sentences.zh: 他们想按照公园里的实际位置来摆放它们。

sentences.en: And they had to rent these cannons from a prop house.
sentences.zh: 而且他们必须从道具店租这些大炮。

sentences.en: He said when they went to rent them, some of the cannons were in a distressed state and they required cosmetic repair because the prop house said, You know,
sentences.zh: 他说当他们去租的时候，有些大炮处于破损状态，需要进行外观修复，因为道具店说，你知道吗，

sentences.en: these were used and gone with the wind.
sentences.zh: 这些可是《乱世佳人》里用过的。

sentences.en: He went on to say that the prop rental house had a historic inventory.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，那家道具租赁公司有着历史悠久的库存。

sentences.en: Now, you can't always 100 percent, like, be accurate about where they were used and everything,
sentences.zh: 当然，你不能百分之百确定它们具体是在哪里用过的，以及所有细节，

sentences.en: but apparently the lore of these cannons were that they were the same ones used in the movie Gone with the Wind.
sentences.zh: 但据说这些大炮的传说就是它们和电影《乱世佳人》里用的是同一批。

sentences.en: They kept those a long time.
He also said one of the things he remembers is the existing structure that they made to look like the Gettysburg visitor center was actually a public restroom.
sentences.zh: 他还说他记得的一件事是，他们为了看起来像葛底斯堡游客中心而搭建的现有建筑，其实原本是个公共厕所。

sentences.en: I have to be honest with you.
When I saw it in the episode, I thought, Is that a bathroom?
sentences.zh: 我在剧集里看到它的时候，心想，那是个厕所吗？

sentences.en: He said that, you know, covered it.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，他们把那儿遮住了。

sentences.en: And then right as you enter, they built sort of like a fake wall.
sentences.zh: 就在你进去的地方，他们建了一堵假墙之类的东西。

sentences.en: But if you went just around the corner, there was a row of toilets.
sentences.zh: 但如果你绕过拐角，那里有一排厕所。

sentences.en: That is so funny because, you know, Angela, you and I weren't there.
sentences.zh: 这太搞笑了，因为，你知道，安吉拉，你和我当时不在那儿。

sentences.en: We stay back at the office.
So I love all that detail.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢这些细节。

sentences.en: I did find in an early draft that we were sent of the table read that my character went.
sentences.zh: 我确实在发给我们的剧本围读初稿里发现，我的角色去了。

sentences.en: What did you do the whole time?
But I guess someone changed their mind, and I'm so glad.
sentences.zh: 但我猜有人改变了主意，我真庆幸。

sentences.en: Because it meant, A, I got to be with you, and I got to be in an air-conditioned room for the whole week because it was hot.
sentences.zh: 因为这意味着，第一，我可以和你在一起，第二，我可以在有空调的房间里待上一整周，因为当时天气很热。

sentences.en: I'm so glad he got back with you.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴他回到你身边了。

sentences.en: Well, fast fact number two, I thought we could use a teeny tiny history lesson on the Battle of Gettysburg.
sentences.zh: 好吧，第二个冷知识，我想我们可以来上一堂关于葛底斯堡战役的小小历史课。
那场战役发生在1863年7月1日至3日。

sentences.en: You know, just because we're there in the episode.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就因为我们在剧集里去了那里。
好吧，费舍尔教授，请继续。

sentences.en: The Battle of Gettysburg was led by Union Army General George Meade.
sentences.zh: 葛底斯堡战役由联邦军将军乔治·米德指挥。

sentences.en: And this is the battle that ended the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 这就是结束了内战的那场战役。

sentences.en: The Gettysburg National Cemetery and Gettysburg National Military Park are maintained by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 葛底斯堡国家公墓和葛底斯堡国家军事公园由美国国家公园管理局维护。

sentences.en: And four months after this battle is when President Abraham Lincoln delivered the famous Gettysburg Address.
sentences.zh: 在那场战役四个月后，亚伯拉罕·林肯总统发表了著名的《葛底斯堡演说》。

sentences.en: You know, the one that begins the four score and seven years ago.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是那篇以“八十七年前”开头的演说。

sentences.en: And that address also contains the famous line, quote, government of the people by the people for the people.
sentences.zh: 那篇演说还包含了那句名言：“民有、民治、民享的政府”。

sentences.en: Gettysburg is located in Adams County, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 葛底斯堡位于宾夕法尼亚州的亚当斯县。

sentences.en: And it's about two hours and 45 minutes away from Scranton.
sentences.zh: 距离斯克兰顿大约两小时四十五分钟车程。

sentences.en: So they would have had time to watch Limitless.
sentences.zh: 所以他们应该有时间看完《永无止境》。

sentences.en: Oh, well, I've got a whole lot to say about this time on the bus later.
sentences.zh: 哦，关于这次坐巴士的时间，我之后还有很多话要说。

sentences.en: But basically, yes, Andy made everyone spend six hours round trip on that bus that day.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，没错，安迪那天让每个人在那辆巴士上往返花了六个小时。

sentences.en: Angela, for when we go visit the Gettysburg National Military Park, it is open year-round.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，关于我们去参观葛底斯堡国家军事公园的事，它全年开放。

sentences.en: And you can tour the park by walking.
They have, like, audio tours that you can download on an app.
sentences.zh: 他们有那种可以在应用上下载的语音导览。

sentences.en: You can do it by bus.
We have to do it by horse.
A hundred percent we have to do it by horse.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，我们必须骑马。

sentences.en: That just moved up higher on my liSt.
sentences.zh: 这在我的愿望清单上排名又上升了。

sentences.en: If you can tour it by horse, it gets priority billing.
sentences.zh: 如果能骑马游览，那绝对是首选。

sentences.en: That's a little bit about Gettysburg.
sentences.zh: 关于葛底斯堡就介绍到这里。

sentences.en: Fast fact number three is a crazy, weird thing that Steve Burgess told me happened while
sentences.zh: 第三个冷知识是一件疯狂又奇怪的事，史蒂夫·伯吉斯告诉我，就在
我们拍摄这一集的时候发生的。

sentences.en: You said, I'm going to surprise you on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你说，要在播客里给我个惊喜。

sentences.en: Meredith's van was struck by lightning.
sentences.zh: 梅雷迪思的货车被闪电击中了。

sentences.en: The photo is like a burned out shell of a van.
sentences.zh: 照片看起来就像一辆烧焦的货车空壳。

sentences.en: I thought it looks like a goner to me, but they repaired it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它看起来已经报废了，但他们居然修好了。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a pretty junky looking van.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那本来就是一辆看起来很破旧的货车。

sentences.en: So maybe it having a little lightning distressing wasn't the worst thing.
sentences.zh: 所以也许被闪电劈出点做旧效果也不是什么坏事。

sentences.en: There's like a giant fire hole.
sentences.zh: 上面有个巨大的火烧洞。

sentences.en: In the whole top of the car.
In the whole top of the van.
I think that's what the, I think that's the technical term for it.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是，我想这就是它的专业术语。

sentences.en: But he said that our crew was actually at the technical Emmys.
sentences.zh: 但他提到我们的剧组当时其实是在技术艾美奖现场。

sentences.en: So the technical Emmys are the weekend before the Emmys, and it's where they give Emmys to
sentences.zh: 技术艾美奖是在艾美奖颁奖典礼的前一个周末举行，那是专门颁发给

sentences.en: all of the crew members, editing, sound design, sort of all of those things.
sentences.zh: 所有剧组成员、剪辑、音效设计等这类幕后人员的奖项。

sentences.en: And so our crew was attending the Emmys when they got a phone call that Meredith's van was
sentences.zh: 所以我们的剧组当时正在参加艾美奖，结果接到电话说梅雷迪思的货车

sentences.en: There was so much crap in that van, too, that they just left in there, like set decorating,
sentences.zh: 那辆车里还有好多乱七八糟的东西，他们就直接留在里面了，比如布景装饰，

sentences.en: but it was like Meredith's mess.
sentences.zh: 但那简直就是梅雷迪思的烂摊子。

sentences.en: I mean, what did the fire department think when they came to put that thing out?
sentences.zh: 我是说，消防队赶去灭火时会怎么想？

sentences.en: I will be sharing those pictures.
sentences.zh: 我会把那些照片分享出来的。

sentences.en: You have to send them to me.
Well, that's all I got for Fast Facts.
sentences.zh: 好了，这就是我准备的“快速事实”全部内容了。
我很喜欢你的“快速事实”。

sentences.en: And when we come back, Gabe is holding a real boring meeting in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 等我们回来，盖博正在会议室里开一个超级无聊的会。

sentences.en: We are back, and we're in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 我们回来了，现在在会议室里。

sentences.en: He is outlining Saber's code of conduct, and it's super boring.
sentences.zh: 他正在宣读赛博公司的行为准则，超级无聊。

sentences.en: If there's an award for fake yawn acting, I think I should receive it, because at 11
sentences.zh: 如果有一个假装打哈欠的演技奖，我觉得我应该拿奖，因为在11

sentences.en: seconds, I do a real great fake yawn.
sentences.zh: 秒的时候，我表演了一个非常棒的假哈欠。

sentences.en: But yeah, Kelly says, oh, my God, kill me.
sentences.zh: 然后凯莉说，天哪，杀了我吧。

sentences.en: And Andy's like, hey, all right.
Obviously, we all want to die, but we have to get through this.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们都想死，但我们必须熬过去。

sentences.en: This is when Pam says, oh, I'm going into labor.
sentences.zh: 就在这时帕姆说，哦，我要生了。

sentences.en: Which I guess she's been doing a lot.
sentences.zh: 我想她最近经常这么说。

sentences.en: They're like, you are not going into labor.
But then, oh, my gosh, her water breaks.
sentences.zh: 但随后，天哪，她羊水破了。

sentences.en: She really is going into labor.
And people are like, oh, my gosh, okay.
sentences.zh: 大家反应过来，天哪，好吧。

sentences.en: And then a water bottle falls out from between her legs.
sentences.zh: 然后一个水瓶从她两腿之间掉了出来。

sentences.en: It's been duct taped to her thigh.
sentences.zh: 它被用大力胶粘在了她的大腿上。

sentences.en: Yeah, let me tell you about that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，让我跟你说说那件事。

sentences.en: Let me tell you how we did this.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你我们是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: This was really tricky because I had to, and you can see me start to do it.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难，因为我必须……你可以看到我开始做那个动作了。

sentences.en: I had that bottle duct taped to my thigh for real.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的用大力胶把那个瓶子粘在大腿上了。

sentences.en: And then I had to, like, kind of undo the lid to let the water out.
sentences.zh: 然后我得，怎么说呢，把盖子拧开一点让水流出来。

sentences.en: I start, you see me start to do it.
sentences.zh: 我开始做了，你看到我开始做那个动作了。

sentences.en: I kind of start to reach up.
But then I had to also make the water bottle fall on the ground.
sentences.zh: 但之后我还得让水瓶掉到地上。

sentences.en: So there's a cut because then as I'm shuffling out, we had to take the tape off.
